title: Acid
html:
For other possible meanings of Acid in the game, see:  Acid (disambiguation)

⁠Acid is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Acid, see Category:Sources of Acid damage.
  • For creatures weak to Acid, see Category:Vulnerable to Acid.
  • For creatures resistant to Acid, see Category:Resistant to Acid.
  • For creatures immune to Acid, see Category:Immune to Acid.

Sources of Acid damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Acid damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Acid Splash
  •  Chromatic Orb: Acid
  •  Glyph of Warding: Acid
  •  Hunger of Hadar
  •  Melf's Acid Arrow

Class actions

  •  Bite (Dilophosaurus)
  •  Corrosive Spit
  •  Sphere of Elemental Balance: Acid

Special actions

  •  Acid Breath
  •  Bufotoxin
  •  Corrosive Strike
  •  Elemental Cleaver (acid)

Weapons

The following weapons deal Acid damage as part of their regular attacks.

  • None

Equipment

The following equipment add Acid damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Acid damage through other means.

  •  Caustic Band: Weapon attacks deal +2⁠⁠Acid damage.
  •  Fleshmelter Cloak: When a creature deals melee damage to the wearer, it takes 1d4⁠⁠Acid damage.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Acid damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Acid Vial: Deal 2d6⁠⁠Acid in an area.  DEX Save (DC 13) to negate.
  •  Arrow of Acid: Deal +2d4⁠⁠Acid in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to negate.
  •  Brine Barrel: Creates a  Caustic Brine surface dealing 1d4⁠⁠Acid per turn.
  •  Caustic Bulb: Creates a  Caustic Brine surface dealing 1d4⁠⁠Acid per turn.

Interactions

  •  Ichorous Gloves: Upon dealing acid damage, also inflict  Noxious Fumes on the target(s).
  •  Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots:  Acid surfaces do not affect the wearer, and they are resistant to ⁠Acid damage.
  •  Necklace of Elemental Augmentation: When dealing acid damage with a cantrip, adds the spellcasting modifier to the damage.

Notes

  •  Acid Barrel: Creates an  Acid surface upon destruction, but doesn't deal any damage.
